title: Jeff Bezos warns Mamdani on NYC taxes, slams wasteful spending

Bezos previously criticized the city's public school spending and economic policies.

title: How Florida used robot rabbits to tackle Burmese pythons
description: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help control invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic real prey, luring snakes from hiding spots. The robots use AI cameras to detect approaching pythons and alert officials for removal. This technology complements traditional methods like the annual Python Challenge competition. These efforts aim to reduce the significant impact of pythons on native wildlife.

title: 5 years on, 11 rescued South African elephants thriving in the wild
description: In an inspiring study, South African elephants reintroduced into reserves demonstrated remarkable behavior akin to that of free-roaming herds. Researchers observed that these elephants not only adapted seamlessly to their natural habitats but also maintained optimal stress hormone levels. This research underscores the potential for long-term captive elephants to regain their independence, offering a promising outlook for the conservation efforts throughout southern Africa.

title: Africa plans $50bn Congo water diversion to revive shrinking Lake Chad
description: Lake Chad's dramatic shrinkage has brought about severe impacts on the lives of millions. To counteract this crisis, governments are investing in initiatives aimed at rehabilitating the lake's ecosystem. A noteworthy solution includes the ambitious Transaqua project, which seeks to channel water from the Congo River back into Lake Chad. This vital endeavor aims not only to replenish the lake but also to foster economic growth in the surrounding regions.
